title: Twist of Fortune
summary: A +1 morningstar that rerolls low damage and converts target gold into extra damage.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial one-handed morningstar, 5 ft and Dippable. +1 to attacks. Hit for 1d8 + 1 Piercing plus Strength.
fields.Heartstopper: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Hit for 1d4 Piercing plus attack ability modifier. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Chest Trauma for 2 turns. It removes one Action, leaving Bonus Actions and Reactions available. Undead and Constructs are immune.
fields.Concussive Smash: Action once per Short Rest with proficiency. Deal weapon damage. Constitution save against the higher of spell save DC or weapon-action DC +2 prevents Dazed for 2 turns. Dazed strips the Dexterity AC bonus, gives Disadvantage on Wisdom saves and prevents spending Reactions. Help clears it.
fields.Twist of Fortune: Reroll damage dice of 1 or 2 on all melee damage rolls while equipped, then take the new result. The passive stacks with a second copy or with Knife of the Undermountain King.
fields.Tenacity: On a main-hand melee miss, optionally spend a Reaction to deal Bludgeoning damage equal to Strength modifier, minimum 1. Uses the Tenacity reaction even when the weapon’s normal hit deals Piercing. Can trigger eligible on-hit effects. On a missed weapon action it does not trigger that action’s special effect.
fields.Blood Money: Action once per Short Rest. Hit for weapon damage and extra Piercing equal to proficiency bonus for each full 300 gp carried by the target. Consumes gold in those 300 gp increments.
fields.Acquisition: Gerringothe Thorm at the Reithwin Tollhouse.
